criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Rendered, dark, single accent; 9 the best. Frame 3 has a flat black plane cutting the car with no brown water, ledge or bank. Frame 5's instances are box slabs between black aisles. Frame 4's water reads as a hole. Frame 2 is flat side-on with a pale orange wash. The hero is a boxy kit SUV.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One car, one world, one accent, one dark register; two devices work; frames 7 and 8 sit slightly outside the street world.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. Slide 4's hook turns the record's may into an event resting on TPR's paraphrase; the deck never says service came back before October 14th; slide 9 gives Saenz's statement to the airport; #BexarCounty names a county no claim carries; the blue band is a ground ring.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and the stake named; the next step general; 26E026 only in the first comment; May 1st unexplained; no resumption.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, turn at 3 lands, 4 to 8 build, the close soft.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, specific, attributed; several flat lines; little Texas texture beyond place names.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: No. 50's San Antonio night flood world four days earlier; one object per day and one per unit fields repeat recent decks.

one_sentence_fix: Put TPR's May 10th report that Waymo was set to return on frame 6 and in the caption so 177 days can't read as a shutdown.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Car sunk in a flat black void; no ledges, brown water or bank; dead zone below the waterline.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pale limestone ledges 6 to 10 m behind lit by the bank lamp; water brown at about 0.7 opacity with the ripple catching the lamp across the doors.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Box slabs with a dome dot; wide black aisles.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower the camera to about 9 m with a longer lens; bevel the low detail bodies and rake the windshield.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Opaque black rectangle reads as a hole; green verge band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Two streetlights behind the median mirrored as streaks; the sheet across both lanes with a comal edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat side-on car on a pale orange wash; mid tone near half.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera at 1.0 m swung 20 degrees to a front three-quarter; a tight pool on the car, rider and curb.
